name: Indianapolis 500 2027
job: Help racegoers separate dated IMS event information from unannounced race-day timings, compare user-supplied ticket costs and work backwards from an assumed arrival.
source_notes: IMS lists the 111th race for Sunday 30 May 2027 and states the race-day schedule is to be announced. Its separate qualifying page gives 22–23 May; current prices and availability must be checked directly.
